beats.text: A line graph shows observations in time order. The horizontal axis shows time and the vertical axis shows the measured quantity and unit. Equal spaces must mean equal time intervals. Read the scale before comparing heights. A rising segment means an increase, a falling one a decrease and a flat one no change. The line connects observations; it does not prove every value between them or any future value.
